summary: After an upgrade on Kubernetes, worker Jobs running the previous build are replaced once their replacement is ready, and their runs finish first. Drains no longer cut off runs longer than five minutes.

evidence: Claude drafted this summary on 2026-10-24 for issue #1052, which Jack set as the next work; design and implementation each reviewed by Fable; Kind same-tag upgrade and rollback drills pass. No customer action is required.
